---
title: "Changelog"
execute:
  freeze: false
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Render the changelog directly from the stochtree package's NEWS.md at build
# time (converting R-style dev suffixes .9000 -> -dev). Done as a code chunk
# rather than a static include so `quarto render` is self-contained: no
# pre-generated file and no pre-render ordering dependency. Tolerates a missing
# NEWS.md. Path candidates cover both execute-dir modes (file vs project root).
candidates <- c("../stochtree_repo/NEWS.md", "stochtree_repo/NEWS.md")
news_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
if (length(news_path) > 0) {
  cat(gsub("\\.9000", "-dev", readLines(news_path[1], warn = FALSE)), sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("_No changelog available for this build._\n")
}
```
